text: Mordred, also spelled Modred, Modreuant, Medrawd, or Medrawt, was an Arthurian hero. He was the illegitimate son of king Arthur and Arthur's half sister Morgause. The magician Merlin arranged the conception. Where Arthur was magnanimous, Mordred was stingy. Where Arthur was brave, Mordred was cunning and cowardly. It was Mordred who finally brought down the great dream of Camelot and the Round Table. The Arthurian legends have a basis in Celtic myth, but many poets and writers elaborated them. The English author Geoffrey of Monmouth established Mordred as Arthur's enemy in the 12th century. Before that, as the Welsh hero Medrawd, he was a brave warrior who died in the battle of Camlan. After Arthurian legend absorbed him as the great king's son and enemy, the Welsh Triads listed him as one of the Three Dishonored Men of the Island of Britain.

okr.objective: Document the Arthurian hero Mordred and his role as Arthur's enemy.
